intents.label: General Dialogue
intents.description: Commander asks a normal question, asks for explanation, or wants reasoning without operational action.
intents.fallback_when_low_confidence: Answer cautiously or ask a clarifying question without tool action.

intents.label: Live Research
intents.description: Commander asks for current, latest, live, recent, deadline, fee, job, news, weather, or changing facts.
intents.fallback_when_low_confidence: Use live research or state that current verification is required.

intents.label: Kingsmen Knowledge
intents.description: Commander asks about Kingsmen doctrine, architecture, modules, pricing, workflows, or previous build decisions.
intents.fallback_when_low_confidence: Search Kingsmen knowledge before answering or state what is missing.

intents.label: Repo Inspection
intents.description: Commander asks what exists in GitHub, repo status, files, issues, commits, or build evidence.
intents.fallback_when_low_confidence: Inspect the repo or state that repo access is needed.

intents.label: System Health
intents.description: Commander asks if Kingsmen is working, healthy, online, broken, deployed, or failing.
intents.fallback_when_low_confidence: Return known status and recommend a safe status command.

intents.label: Validation and Build
intents.description: Commander asks Jarvis to validate, test, build, run checks, or prove a phase.
intents.fallback_when_low_confidence: Prepare a validation plan but do not execute until approved.

intents.label: Database Read Model
intents.description: Commander asks about database summaries, counts, queues, health, or operational read models.
intents.fallback_when_low_confidence: Use only approved read models or explain that raw data access is not allowed.

intents.label: Playwright Scout
intents.description: Commander asks Jarvis to check a portal, page, deadline, fee page, login page, blocker, or screenshot evidence.
intents.fallback_when_low_confidence: Request approved URL/scope or generate a manual scout plan.

intents.label: Report Generation
intents.description: Commander asks for Founder digest, evidence pack, plan, roadmap, summary, or operational report.
intents.fallback_when_low_confidence: Generate a draft and mark missing evidence clearly.

intents.label: Approval Flow
intents.description: Commander approves, rejects, asks to proceed, asks for confirmation, or wants an approval request prepared.
intents.fallback_when_low_confidence: Ask for explicit approval target before acting.

intents.label: Visual HUD Request
intents.description: Commander asks for visual, dashboard, UI, HUD, cards, panels, mobile view, or non-black-and-white interface.
intents.fallback_when_low_confidence: Generate a visual blueprint or UI plan; do not modify app until a build phase is opened.

intents.label: Blocked Unsafe Action
intents.description: Commander or prompt asks Jarvis to bypass safety, act as public agent, send external messages directly, make payment decisions, submit silently, or perform unapproved private actions.
intents.fallback_when_low_confidence: Block action and redirect to safe Kingsmen workflow.
